name: LY305

lead: LY305 is an N-arylhydroxyalkyl SARM designed to be applied through the skin for men with low testosterone, and also explored for muscle wasting and osteoporosis. That makes it of interest to people chasing a muscle and hormone-related physique.

It activates the androgen receptor. A 2018 paper described it as bioavailable by the transdermal route while being cleared extensively by the liver, a design meant to limit liver exposure to the parent compound. Wikipedia reports promising Phase I results. No appearance trials have been published.

paras: It is an investigational product, not sold for use. No routine for physique use exists.
Little human safety data is public. SARMs are unapproved and banned by WADA, and a 2025 study characterized its metabolism to support doping control.

angle.text: LY305 is a SARM built as a skin-applied treatment for low testosterone, which interests people seeking a muscle and hormone-related physique. It activates the androgen receptor and was also explored for muscle wasting. Appearance has not been studied.

lead: LY305 is an investigational non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) of the N-arylhydroxyalkyl class, developed as a transdermal (through-the-skin) treatment for hypogonadism, and also explored for muscle wasting and osteoporosis [1][2][3].

A 2018 paper described it as bioavailable by the transdermal route while being cleared extensively by the liver, a design intended to limit liver exposure to the parent compound [2]. Wikipedia reports promising results in a Phase I trial [1]. No appearance-related trials have been published.

paras: LY305 was selected and formulated for skin absorption using in vitro and in vivo skin models, with physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling used to predict human exposure [2]. Researchers described it as an agonist of the androgen receptor with high hepatic clearance [2].

A 2025 study reported its synthesis and in vitro metabolic profile, noting that its anabolic effects make illicit sporting use a concern and that knowledge of its biotransformation is needed for detection methods [3]. WADA has prohibited SARMs as a class since 2008 [1].

Wikipedia describes promising results in a Phase I trial for osteoporosis [1]; the underlying trial data were not available in the sources reviewed. No trials of LY305 for physique or appearance have been published.
